query:
UPDATE tasks
        SET title = ?, description = ?, due_date = ?, priority = ?,
            completed = ?, completed_at = ?, rrule = ?,
            caldav_etag = ?, raw_icalendar = ?,
            synced_version = local_version, sync_status = 'synced',
            updated_at = ?
        WHERE caldav_href = ?
